==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Quests|
{{BotW Quest
 |name= The Statue's Bargain
 |type= Side Quest
 |giver= Horned Statue
 |location= [[Hateno Village]]
}}
}}
The Horned Statue is found along the path to [[Firly Pond]] in [[Hateno Village]]. [[Link]] can speak to [[Teebo]] to be guided to the Horned Statue's exact location,<ref name="BotW Teebo"/> though Teebo has no knowledge of what the Statue is meant for.<ref name="BotW Teebo 2"/>

If Link prays to the Horned Statue, he will note that there are still people who pay him homage.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue"/> When Link reacts with shock, the Horned Statue is surprised that he is able to be heard.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 2"/> If Link denies hearing his voice, the Horned Statue says he makes bargains with those who can hear him.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 3"/> He asks Link if he was praying for a long life or wealth, promising that he can grant these requests.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 4"/>

The Horned Statue explains that he was once a person who made bargains by trading people's [[Essence]]s. The Goddess, [[Hylia]], disapproved of his heinous dealings and smote him by trapping him inside the Horned Statue.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 5"/> Since then, he has been neglected by the residents of Hateno Village.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 6"/> Despite this, the spirit of the Horned Statue remained headstrong and chose to bide his time waiting for another person to make a deal with him.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 7"/> He asks Link if he would like to strike a bargain.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 8"/> Without waiting for an answer, he steals either a [[Heart Container]] or a [[Stamina Vessel]] from him.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 9"/> This initiates "[[The Statue's Bargain]]" [[Side Quest]], tasking Link with the responsibility of recovering his stolen Essence.<ref name="BotW Adventure Log"/>

In speaking to the Horned Statue once again, he at first pretends not to understand why Link is upset.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 10"/> When Link demands his stolen Essence back, the Horned Statue is offended that Link believes he was deceived.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 11"/> He promises Link that they will have a profitable relationship, and he explains that for a price, he will give him either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 12"/> When Link chooses which one to receive, the Horned Statue tells him to stay still as he returns his Essence to him.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 13"/>

Afterwards, the Horned Statue notices that Link is skeptical, and he explains that he sees money and life as the same thing.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 14"/>He explains that Link can sell either of his Essences to him for 100 [[Rupee]]s and buy it back for 120 Rupees.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 15"/> However, he allows Link to choose whether he receives a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 16"/> Link can begin this process by praying to the Horned Statue again.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 17"/> After this, the Side Quest will be completed.

When Link approaches the Horned Statue, he asks if he has come to tamper with his Essences.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 18"/> If the Horned Statue is not currently holding any Essences, he will ask Link if he is willing to sell them.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 19"/> The Horned Statue will only take the Essence that Link asks him to.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 20"/> Through this process, Link is able to transfer the upgrades that he has received from [[Goddess Statue]]s from Heart Containers to Stamina Vessels, or vice versa.

If Link attempts to sell his Heart Containers or Stamina Vessels beyond their default limitations (3 Hearts and 1 full Stamina Wheel), the Horned Statue will reject his request.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 21"/><ref name="BotW Horned Statue 22"/> Additionally, if Link tries to speak to the Horned Statue before he has received any blessings from Hylia, he will be turned away and instructed to return with something to trade.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 23"/>

The Horned Statue reappears in {{TotK}}. He can be found in the [[Royal Hidden Passage]].

==Trivia==
* In the German and Latin American Spanish versions of {{BotW|-}}, the Horned Statue says that he is a deity of life and strength.<ref name="BotW Horned Statue 24"/><ref name="BotW Horned Statue 25"/>
* If Link tries to sell an Essence to the Horned Statue with 999,999 Rupees in {{BotW|-}}, the game will softlock.<ref name="BotW Youtube"/>
* The maximum number of Essences that can be stored in the Horned Statue varies based on the game. In {{BotW|-}} it is 65,535, which is the maximum value that can be stored in a 16-bit integer field. In {{TotK|-}} it is 2,147,483,647, which is the maximum value that can be stored in a 32-bit integer field. Neither value is possible to attain without the use of glitches or save editing.

==Nomenclature==
In many languages (including the original Japanese), the Horned Statue is called "Demon Statue", "Statue of the Devil" or "Evil Statue", which has been removed from the English localization.
